title: Cosmic Cowboy Rider
description: A spectral cowboy in a dark hat and glowing white eyes rides a translucent green horse through a swirling psychedelic vortex. He holds a smartphone in one hand while the horse's head contains a circular portal showing a night landscape with a crescent moon; additional floating bubbles display cowboy boots and a glowing city.
prompt: A ghostly cowboy with glowing white eyes wearing a dark hat and bandana rides a translucent green and purple horse through a swirling cosmic vortex of bubbles and glowing particles. He holds up a smartphone. The horse's head is a circular window showing a night landscape with crescent moon. Floating bubbles contain images of cowboy boots and a neon city. In the background is a serene mountain lake reflecting a colorful sunset sky with dramatic clouds. Swirling text border. Highly detailed digital painting with vibrant colors and surreal elements.
